A1.justification: Both complete 26-page PDFs describe EpiDistill and include eight pages of supplementary material. Text, equations, figures and tables support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction, depth-estimation and scale-generalization experiments, plus ablations and adaptation results in Figure 1, Tables 1–4 and supplementary Tables S1–S3.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical evaluations, including the supplementary adaptation experiments and ablations.

M1.justification: Sections 4 and 4.3 replace arithmetic-mean normalization with median normalization for the baseline depth and ground-truth structural target. This changes the specified representation and training target; the architecture and other losses remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E1.justification: Both retain the same seven training datasets, eight zero-shot depth benchmarks, ScanNet++ reconstruction, DepthPerturb dolly-zoom tests and DIODE/KITTI adaptation experiments.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments. Tables 1–2 retain Metric3DV2, DepthAnything3, UniDepthV1, UniK3D, MoGe-2 and the two host models; the scale-generalization and ablation comparisons also retain their comparator sets.

E3.justification: The documented sampling, image resizing, training budgets, model configurations, evaluation metrics and adaptation protocols are retained. The normalization revision concerns the method and loss definition, rather than a changed evaluation procedure.

E4.justification: The DGEA/RST ablations, loss-component and hyperparameter sensitivity tests, token adaptation, metric-versus-relative-depth comparison and attention visualizations are unchanged in the main text and supplement.

E5.justification: Figure 1 retains identical error bars. Neither version adds or revises run counts, seeds, uncertainty definitions, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Section 5.2 removes the claimed 33.4% DIODE A.Rel improvement for DepthPro. The unchanged Table 1 values, 0.386 versus 0.357, support approximately 7.5%, already reported in Table S2. The 44.7% UniDepthV2 statement and all tabulated results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions of baseline-depth normalization and the normalized ground-truth target in Equation 8 change from means to medians. Equation 10 retains mean-based scale supervision. The epipolar derivations are unchanged, with no new proofs or theorems.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about transferring multi-view geometry, preserving epipolar attention during monocular inference and improving metric depth across different host models.

C2.justification: The interpretations concerning geometric anchors, scale correction, virtual baselines and excessive Gaussian bias under occlusions or dynamic objects are retained. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added or removed.

D1.justification: The first-page Project Link changes from a GitHub repository to a project website, changing the access destination. The PDFs do not establish a change in code availability. Hardware, hyperparameters and supplementary implementation details are retained.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning and cited-work sets are unchanged in both the main paper and supplement.

P1.justification: Localized wording changes accompany the normalization revision and removal of the DepthPro percentage. The supplementary cover loses its duplicate author and affiliation block. Section order and the broader exposition remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The supplementary cover becomes more compact, moving Figure S1 upward. Text and table placement reflow, and the supplementary metric formulas move from page 8 to page 7. Existing figures and tables are retained without substantive redesign.

improvement.justification: Removing the unsupported 33.4% DepthPro statement improves reporting accuracy. However, unlike v1, v2 median-normalizes the structural target in Equation 8 while retaining mean-based scale supervision in Equation 10. Under Equation 1, matching both targets therefore produces a mean-to-median scale error. This new inconsistency weakens the central method specification and reproducibility; the unchanged results and supplement do not resolve it.
